problem.title: Twenty-Third Power of Seven
problem.statement: What is the units digit of 7²³?

solutionSteps.title: Locate the exponent
solutionSteps.body: Since 23=4×5+3, select slot 3 of the cycle, which contains 3.

validationMethods: independent modular exponent split 7^23 equals (7^4)^5 times 7^3 modulo 10
notes: Both methods give units digit three.

problem.title: A One-Step Cycle
problem.statement: What is the units digit of 26¹⁰⁰?
hints: Reduce the base to units digit 6.
Multiply 6 by 6 and inspect the units digit.

solutionSteps.title: Verify the fixed state
solutionSteps.body: Powers of a number ending in 6 always end in 6, so 26¹⁰⁰ has units digit 6.

validationMethods: verified cycle 6 times 6 returns to 6 modulo 10
independent induction that multiplying any number ending in 6 by 6 preserves units digit 6
notes: The cycle length is one, not four.

problem.title: The Exponent Is an Index
problem.statement: What is the units digit of 3⁵⁰?

solutionSteps.title: Reduce and read
solutionSteps.body: 50=4×12+2, so select slot 2 of the cycle, value 9.

validationMethods: independent modular calculation 3^50 equals (3^4)^12 times 3^2 modulo 10
notes: The exponent remainder two is an index, not the answer digit.

problem.title: Add Two Cycle Values
problem.statement: What is the units digit of 2³¹+3³¹?
hints: Both cycles have length 4, and 31 has remainder 3.
Read slot 3 from each cycle before adding.

solutionSteps.title: Read both cycles
solutionSteps.body: Slot 3 of [2,4,8,6] is 8, and slot 3 of [3,9,7,1] is 7.

validationMethods: independent lookup in two explicit cycles
modular calculation using exponent 31 congruent to 3 modulo 4
notes: The selected residues sum to fifteen.

problem.title: A Cycle Inside the Exponent
problem.statement: What is the units digit of 7^(2²⁰)?

solutionSteps.title: Reduce the exponent
solutionSteps.body: Because 2²⁰ is divisible by 4, the exponent selects the final slot of [7,9,3,1].

validationMethods: independent modular identity 7^4 congruent to 1 modulo 10 applied to an exponent multiple of four
notes: The nested exponent need not be evaluated.
